Card Q&A.a: Effects with the [Hand] icon can activate when their card is revealed from the hand. If your breeding area is empty, this effect can activate during the main phase when you reveal this card from the hand and process the effect.
Card Q&A.q: How do I activate this card's [Hand] [Main] effect?

Effect: [Hand] [Main] If your breeding area is empty, by returning 1 Digimon card with the [Three Great Angels] trait from your trash to the bottom of the deck, play this Digimon card into the breeding area without paying the cost.
